description: This Java source file defines the TestBase class, which provides methods to query, test, and compare task hierarchies in an Android application. It includes functionality to launch activities using different strategies and manages task stack building.

classes.name: TestBase
classes.description: A class that manages launching and testing activity task hierarchies in Android.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the task hierarchy and context.
